snippet.title: RAKKA: WAKE 01 - SOOT (Official Announcement Teaser)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3455080/RAKKA_WAKE_01__SOOT/

We are extremely excited to announce the first videogame developed by the PMT Games Division!

"RAKKA: WAKE 01 - SOOT" is a visual novel about 4 friends going on an unexpected adventure. Players progress through the story by exploring characters, dialogues, and uncovering clues that are crucial to understanding the answers that slowly unravel at the heart of this game. Based on a conceptual arts and music project, this game is especially sonically-driven, using its soundtrack to enhance the atmosphere and immerse players in the unfolding tension, that goes hand-in hand with it’s unique hand-drawn, paper-cut style.

Featuring:
GITGOT (Herself)
Pascal van den Bos (Kev)
KiddleScribbles (Voiceover)
Rakka (Paper)
Kev (Paper)

Music by:
Pascal van den Bos & GITGOT

Artwork by:
GITGOT
